title: Snap the Lid Shut
setup: Black's king is wedged on h8 behind its own pawn on h7, and your king on f7 stands right next to its escape squares.
hint: Step the rook up the g-file — your king and Black's pawn close the lid.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Rg8#}} checks the king from the square next to it. Your king on f7 guards g8, so the king cannot take the rook. g7 is covered by your king and by the rook, and h7 holds Black's own pawn.

When your king guards a square beside the enemy king, the rook can give check from right there.
